cds.title: University of Illinois Springfield Common Data Set 2025-2026 (Excel workbook, Office of Institutional Research data book)

ipeds.title: IPEDS via College Navigator - University of Illinois Springfield (student-faculty ratio)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 entering class): 69 international first-year applicants, 65 admitted, 12 enrolled. The CDS reports no waitlist; early action closing date is Dec. 1 with rolling notification. Percentiles are as printed in C9 for the 92 SAT and 13 ACT submitters; the workbook's ACT sub-score rows look mis-aligned, so only the ACT composite is kept. Undergraduate enrollment 2,337 and nonresident undergraduates 77 are from CDS section B (fall 2025).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'; C8F says test optional, scores may be used for course placement.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5 (first-year, 2026-27): nonresident tuition 20,400; fees exclude student health insurance. UIS's cost page (updated 2026-08-31) estimates $9,957 tuition plus $10,038 for nonresidents and a total of about $40,435 on campus for nonresidents. CDS H6: institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 52 received it (average $13,083); the awarded field holds the recipient count.
